# Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers

> Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers is Jharkhand's premier IBA-approved and ISO 9001:2015 certified relocation company, specializing in household goods shifting, corporate office relocation, car carrier transport, motorcycle shipping, safe warehousing, and transit insurance across all 24 districts of Jharkhand and pan-India destinations.

## Core Relocation Services

1. [Residential Shifting](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/residential-shifting/): Complete home relocation for 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK apartments, villas, and bungalows with multi-layer packing, careful dismantling, and room-by-room reassembly.
2. [Business Shifting](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/business-shifting/): Zero-downtime corporate office shifting, modular workstation dismantling, IT server rack moving, executive desk handling, and archive management.
3. [Vehicle Shifting](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/vehicle-shifting/): Scratch-free door-to-door car carrier transport via closed container trucks and two-wheeler bike parcel packing in wooden crates.
4. [Packing and Unpacking](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/packing-and-unpacking/): 4-layer and 5-layer protective packing utilizing virgin bubble wrap, corrugated sheets, foam edge-guards, and moisture-resistant stretch film.
5. [Loading and Unloading](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/loading-and-unloading-services/): Professional heavy lifters, hydraulic ramps, moving dollies, and safety cargo straps for safe handling of heavy furniture and appliances.
6. [Warehouse & Storage Services](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/warehouse-service/): 24/7 CCTV-monitored, moisture-free, pest-controlled short-term and long-term household storage facilities in Ranchi and Bokaro.
7. [Domestic Pan-India Moving](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/domestics-service/): Daily direct container trucks connecting Jharkhand to Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Patna, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, and Chennai.
8. [International Relocation](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/international-service/): Worldwide air and sea freight moving, customs clearance support, and ISPM-15 export-grade wooden crating.
9. [Transit Insurance Services](https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/insurance-service/): Comprehensive all-risk transit insurance policies covering unforeseen accidental risks with transparent 7-day claim settlements.

## Regional Coverage & Network (All 24 Districts of Jharkhand)

Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers operates full-service relocation fleets across every district in Jharkhand:
- **Central Jharkhand**: Ranchi (HQ), Ramgarh, Khunti
- **Coal Belt & Industrial Hubs**: Dhanbad, Bokaro Steel City, Giridih
- **South & Kolhan Division**: East Singhbhum (Jamshedpur), West Singhbhum (Chaibasa), Saraikela-Kharsawan
- **North Chotanagpur**: Hazaribagh, Koderma, Chatra
- **Palamu Division**: Palamu (Medininagar / Daltonganj), Garhwa, Latehar
- **Santhal Pargana**: Deoghar, Dumka, Godda, Jamtara, Pakur, Sahibganj
- **South Chotanagpur / Western Belt**: Gumla, Lohardaga, Simdega
- **Total Localities & Sub-Divisions Covered**: 158 verified towns including Jharia, Katras, Sindri, Bermo, Phusro, Chas, Ormanjhi, Adityapur, Ghatshila, Chakulia, and Madhupur.
